description: Toast notifications rendered by the Sonner library. Uses aria-live regions to announce messages to screen readers. Non-urgent toasts use aria-live="polite" while error or critical toasts use aria-live="assertive". Toasts auto-dismiss after a timeout.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to action buttons within the toast if present
Activates the focused action button within the toast

focus.notes: Toasts do not steal focus on appearance. Focus can be moved to the toast if it contains interactive elements (action buttons, close button). Focus is not trapped — Tab moves focus out of the toast.

announcements: Toast message is announced via aria-live region when it appears
Non-urgent toasts (success, info) use aria-live="polite" and wait for current speech
Error and critical toasts use aria-live="assertive" and interrupt current speech
Action buttons within the toast are announced as interactive elements
screenReader.notes: Auto-dismiss timing should be generous enough for screen reader users to perceive and act on the message. Consider providing a way to pause auto-dismiss on hover or focus.

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA — toast text uses appropriate foreground on toast background
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA — close button and action buttons meet 3:1 contrast ratio

motion.reducedMotion: Slide and fade animations respect prefers-reduced-motion

consumerResponsibilities: Use appropriate toast types (success, error, info) to set correct aria-live politeness
Ensure auto-dismiss duration is long enough for users to read the message
Provide a close button for toasts that contain actions
Do not use toasts for critical information that requires user acknowledgment — use a dialog instead
